IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Highways & Transportation.

Bill.BriefDescription: Removing a fixed schedule of license plate replacement.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to license plate replacement; and amending RCW46.16.233.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.16.233 and 2000 c 37 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except for those license plates issued under RCW 46.16.305(1)before January 1, 1987, under RCW 46.16.305(3), and to commercialvehicles with a gross weight in excess of twentysix thousand pounds,effective with vehicle registrations due or to become due on January 1,2001, all vehicle license plates must be issued on a standardbackground, as designated by the department. ((Additionally, to ensuremaximum legibility and reflectivity, the department shall periodicallyprovide for the replacement of license plates, except for commercialvehicles with a gross weight in excess of twentysix thousand pounds.Frequency of replacement shall be established in accordance withempirical studies documenting the longevity of the reflective materials p. 1 SB 5330used to make license plates.))
